verdict.rationale: Teams documents bots that take part in conversations, a quickstart for building an agent users chat with, and Outgoing Webhooks that push channel text messages to a developer's web service. Together these show a real-time inbound message path for a bot. The pack does not document an events API or gateway connection covering broader event types such as reactions, membership changes or conversation updates, nor how events are delivered or subscribed to. Missing for 10: documented real-time event delivery beyond channel text messages, an explicit events API or gateway connection model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a bot that receives messages and events in real time through an events API or gateway connection
